name: fileId
label: File or folder ID
help: The ID of the file or folder, from a search, a list or a trigger.

name: name
label: Name
help: The new name, without a path. Folders keep their place.

name: conflict
label: If the name is taken
help: What to do when the name is taken: "Fail" stops with an error, and "Rename" uses "name (1)".
